records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the second quarter of 2022, Ukraine generated 0.2% and Russia generated 3.7% of consolidated net revenue and during the second quarter of 2023, Ukraine generated 0.3% and Russia generated 2.8% of consolidated net revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Overall, our net revenue growth in both the second quarter and first six months of 2023 was driven by higher net pricing, incremental net revenues from our acquisitions of Clif Bar and Ricolino in 2022 and favorable volume/mix (reflecting growth in the first quarter while the second quarter was flat), partially offset by unfavorable currency translation and the impact of divestitures in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our Russian net revenues declined in the second quarter of 2023 due to the suspension of advertising as well as currency weakness that more than offset increased pricing.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, we experienced significantly higher operating costs, including higher overall raw material, transportation, labor and energy costs that have continued to rise.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating Income – Operating income increased $498 million (53.7%) to $1,425 million in the second quarter of 2023.
